implementation: For each active prior-latch-to-flip gap, split time at the request's existing validateSwap timestamp. Arrival is time after the prior latch before a new swap appears; post-arrival is time after both the prior latch and request are available until flip.
Requests validated before the prior latch are counted as prequeued. Arrival plus post-arrival equals the corresponding active gap; idle gaps remain excluded.
The existing GPU fence wait counters are exported in the same two-second gap-phase row. No fence, mapping, flip, latch or retirement behavior changed.
verification: The actual cadence methods pass ASan/UBSan for post-latch arrival, post-arrival time, a prequeued request, idle exclusion, confirmed ACK and timeout reset.
The analyzer passes compositor-arrival and GPU-fence routing cases in addition to cadence-a regression cases.
The full 21H461 archive, display ABI audit, link and prelink passed. Packed symbols include native_t970_cadence, native_t970_gap_phase and native_t970_scanout_latches.
Readback preserved the exact cadence-a GPU addon and the same 994-byte boot configuration; payload packing and final Recovery size checks passed.
limits: The result covers one 64-second interactive workload and has no matched reference-port trace. The first uploaded image logged the existing at-least-250-ms fence counter under the historical fence_timeout spelling; the analyzer normalizes it to fence_slow_250ms.
